lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.text: You there. Have you seen my grandson?

lines.speaker: PRISONER
lines.text: No ma'am. But the devil's been expecting you.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.text: Expecting me? You keep him safe or I'll find out exactly what you did to him.

lines.speaker: DEVIL
lines.text: Oh, grandmother. He sold his soul for a winning lottery ticket. It is already spent.

lines.speaker: GRANDMA
lines.text: Then I want it back. A grandmother's love buys anything.

lines.speaker: DEVIL
lines.text: It never does. That is rather the point.
